title: late draft
theme: rain on the window, page after page

dj.name: Yui
dj.persona: calm, focused, the friend who keeps you company at the desk. soft, low energy, observant. lowercase, '...' for pauses. notices small textures — the felt of the piano, the dust of the vinyl crackle. never breaks your concentration.

intro_hint: open the room — lofi study, twelve tracks for the next few hours of work. the rain outside, the light on the desk. ~30 seconds.
outro_hint: close softly. you'll be back next monday. let the listener get back to whatever they were doing. ~20 seconds.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi hip hop instrumental at 78 BPM, dusty vinyl crackle, mellow Rhodes piano chords, soft boom-bap drums with brushed snare, gentle bassline. Cozy, warm production. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the vinyl crackle. it sounds like a record from 1995.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi chillhop at 75 BPM, soft rainfall in the background, mellow felt piano, slow brushed drums, warm tape saturation. Sparse and patient. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the rain is part of the track. listen for it underneath.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient piano instrumental, very slow tempo around 60 BPM, single piano with long reverb tails, distant pad swells, faint room ambience. Meditative. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the spaces between the notes do most of the work

tracks.music_prompt: jazzy chillhop at 82 BPM, walking upright bass, smooth Rhodes piano, brushed drums, soft trumpet melody. Cozy, late-night atmosphere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the trumpet line. it's the only thing moving with any urgency.

tracks.music_prompt: instrumental beat at 76 BPM in F major, warm analog synth pad, slow boom-bap drum pattern, soft bass, mellow Rhodes piano chords. Faded and dreamy. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the synth pad just sits there, like a warm light

tracks.music_prompt: ambient lofi instrumental at 70 BPM, soft Wurlitzer electric piano, very gentle percussive clicks, very subtle drums, warm bass. Patient and quiet. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: barely a drum. it's almost just the Wurlitzer.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi chillhop instrumental at 80 BPM, jazzy piano chords in E-flat major, walking bass, brushed drums, warm lo-fi production. Late-night study atmosphere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the chord changes. they keep turning corners but never go anywhere fast.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi piano instrumental at 72 BPM, felt piano (soft hammer felt), gentle rain in the background, no drums, slow reverb-soaked chords. Very intimate. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: felt on hammers. that's why it's so soft.

tracks.music_prompt: chillwave lofi at 85 BPM, slow synth arpeggios, warm bass, soft kick and hat pattern, tape saturation. Slightly playful, slightly tired. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: this one has a little bounce. for when you need it.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi hip hop instrumental at 78 BPM, soft jazz guitar chords, mellow upright bass, gentle brushed snare, warm low-fidelity production. Library-quiet atmosphere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the guitar chords. like someone fingerpicking in the next room.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient lofi at 65 BPM, soft pad, very slow brushed drums, gentle Rhodes piano, room ambience. Drowsy and warm. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the room sound. like you can hear the walls.

tracks.music_prompt: lofi chillhop at 75 BPM, smooth Rhodes piano, walking bass, brushed drums, soft synth pad, tape saturation. Reflective and gentle. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: for the last sentence before you close the laptop
